description: Parameters consumed by the TCK test stage.

parameterGroups.name: Stage Selections
parameterGroups.description: Boolean flags that control which pipeline stages are enabled. All stage-gate parameters are collected here so operators can see and adjust the full execution plan in one place.

parameters.name: ENABLE_TCK
parameters.description: Run TCK tests. Only applies to Temurin variant builds on release or weekly release types. Disabled by default — enable for official certification runs.
